source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To validate HDD hot plug function.

1. Install all drives in a system with a backplane (do not perform test on simple swap)
2. Power up system, and boot in OS.
3. Check all drives status in RAID controller utility.
4. Remove one drive from HDD slot.
5. Wait 30 seconds then insert it back.
6. Do a total of 10 hot removal / insertion cycles.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The HDD can be detected and information is correct in MSM.
2. The log in BMC  shows right.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SSD plug/manual test (10 cycles): physical insert/remove is operator-action. Agent assists by watching enumeration before/after each cycle: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "lsblk -o NAME,SERIAL,MODEL 2>&1" and checking `dmesg -T | tail -30` for clean hot-plug (no errors).
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the enumeration snapshot + `dmesg -T` tail across the plug/unplug cycles so user + operator confirm clean detection/removal each time.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: physical hot-plug requires operator; agent must not power the bay. Confirm drive bay is hot-swap capable.

original_test_intent: Verify that one explicitly safe RAID/backplane drive can be physically removed and reinserted ten times with a 30-second absence each cycle, remains correctly identified in MSM/controller management and produces the expected BMC evidence without data or array failure.
original_method: Establish healthy redundant array and immutable controller/slot/serial mapping, then a qualified operator executes ten remove-wait-30-second-reinsert cycles while automation captures controller physical/virtual-drive state, OS inventory, BMC/SEL events and rebuild behavior at each phase.
manual_activity: The defining stimulus is 20 physical actions—ten removals and ten insertions—performed by a qualified operator. The agent can monitor controller/OS/BMC state but cannot perform or claim those actions, so the complete case is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Exact RAID controller, array/VD, physical slot, drive serial/member role and baseline health
Proof the selected member is safe to remove, with no degraded/rebuild/boot/system risk
Approved MSM/storcli/perccli/ssacli version and read-only status commands
Qualified operator, hot-plug backplane SOP, 10-cycle/30-second timing and maintenance approval
Abort/rebuild/recovery owner and per-cycle evidence matrix
safety_requirements: Never remove a boot/system, non-redundant, unknown, degraded or rebuilding member; positively bind slot and serial.
Operator performs every physical action and stops on resistance, wrong state, power/thermal alarm, I/O/data error or management instability.
Do not power the bay, initiate rebuild/import/clear/initialize or mutate RAID state automatically.
Preserve every cycle and the first anomaly; do not continue to reach 10 after a safety stop or auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate array/member safety and capture controller/OS/BMC baseline.
Timestamp each operator action and collect removal/reinsertion controller, OS and BMC/SEL states for all approved cycles.
Summarize completed cycles, rebuild/final array health and Tool Result without claiming physical execution or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact removable member, redundancy/recovery and maintenance plan.
Perform and attest all ten cycles with 30-second waits and stop on physical/storage anomalies.
Direct recovery/rebuild if needed and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: lsblk and a short dmesg tail cannot satisfy MSM/controller identity, virtual-drive health, rebuild state or BMC criterion. They are supplemental only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain manual cycles and use the controller-matched read-only utility plus target-filtered OS and complete BMC/SEL event windows per cycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: True backplane, all-drive baseline, one selected member, 30-second absence, 10 cycles, MSM/BMC evidence and 80/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL TEN-CYCLE STIMULUS WITH CONTROLLER STATE MACHINE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-cycle ledger that gates each next removal on healthy approved controller state, binds timestamps to BMC/SEL and serial evidence, and records final array/rebuild health.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, controller firmware/driver, MSM/CLI, backplane and drive firmware versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Controller and platform hot-plug/rebuild SOP must define removable-member safety and expected BMC events.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit redundancy gates and auditable state transitions without replacing physical cycling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; ten complete cycles and 30-second waits remain mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong member or continued cycling during degradation can cause array/data loss.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve fewer cycles, but the report must state the count and cannot claim completion of the master ten-cycle case. Normal rebuild behavior must be defined before execution.
expected_evidence: Per-cycle operator timestamps for removal, 30-second wait and reinsertion
Per-cycle MSM/controller/OS/BMC/SEL states including rebuild/degraded transitions
Completed count, final array/data/health state, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently require ten hot-plug cycles with correct controller and BMC behavior.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and acceptance are clear. Missing mapping/tool/recovery are readiness inputs; the physical core is MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains automated telemetry but corrects PARTIAL and restores controller/BMC and array safety coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its detailed RAID safeguards while applying MANUAL ONLY for the physical core.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds a cycle-gated controller state machine and explicit reduced-count claim boundary.

review_improvement: Prevents generic OS detection or unsafe continued cycling from substituting for RAID-aware ten-cycle validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Ten physical removal/reinsertion cycles are the core test operation. No software package or approval can make those physical acts agent-executed, so MANUAL ONLY is required while telemetry remains assistive.
